brief:
With all votes counted, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has fallen short of a parliamentary majority, according to Al Jazeera English. His political bloc won insufficient seats to form a government independently, leaving him dependent on additional coalition partners to govern.

Opposition parties are exploring potential alliances with Palestinian-Israeli parties to challenge Netanyahu's path to power. The configuration raises the possibility that these combined forces could command enough Knesset seats to unseat the current premier and form an alternative government.
dek: With all votes now counted, opposition parties could join forces with Palestinian-Israeli parties to unseat Netanyahu.
title: Netanyahu fails to secure Knesset majority in new election
